title: [Master]-Serial numbers selected on Assembly Order component lines are deleted when running Calculate Regenerative Plan, without carrying out action messages
summary: Serial numbers on assembly order component lines are no longer unexpectedly deleted when running the Calculate Regenerative Plan action.
key_points: Fixed issue where serial numbers assigned to assembly order components were removed during regenerative planning
Added logic to preserve item tracking information during inventory profile calculations
Includes expanded test coverage for serial number handling in assembly order scenarios
